from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

URL = "file:///home/user/project/preview.html"
errors, requests, failed = [], [], []

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 960}, device_scale_factor=2)
    pg.on("console", lambda m: errors.append(f"{m.type}: {m.text}") if m.type in ("error", "warning") else None)
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(f"pageerror: {e}"))
    pg.on("request", lambda r: requests.append(r.url))
    pg.on("requestfailed", lambda r: failed.append(r.url))
    pg.goto(URL)
    pg.wait_for_load_state("load")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(700)

    def state(label):
        mode = pg.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode")
        accent = pg.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--accent').trim()")
        visible = pg.evaluate(
            "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]')].map(s=>s.dataset.panel+':'+(s.hidden?'hidden':'shown')).join(' ')"
        )
        nums = pg.evaluate(
            "getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.readout__value')).fontVariantNumeric"
        )
        status = pg.inner_text("#status-text")
        print(f"[{label}] mode={mode} accent={accent} panels={visible} nums={nums} status={status!r}")

    state("scientific")
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/sci-desktop.png", full_page=True)

    pg.get_by_role("tab", name="Graph").click()
    pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
    state("graph")
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/graph-desktop.png", full_page=True)

    pg.get_by_role("tab", name="Date").click()
    pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
    state("date")
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/date-desktop.png", full_page=True)

    # keyboard: focus date tab, arrow-left should move to graph
    pg.get_by_role("tab", name="Date").focus()
    pg.keyboard.press("ArrowLeft")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
    state("after arrow-left")
    print("focused:", pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent.trim()"))

    # focus ring visibility
    pg.keyboard.press("Tab")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(150)
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/focus-desktop.png")

    print("requests:", requests)
    print("failed:", failed)
    print("console errors:", errors)

    # mobile
    m = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844}, device_scale_factor=2)
    m.goto(URL)
    m.wait_for_timeout(500)
    m.screenshot(path="/tmp/sci-mobile.png", full_page=True)
    m.get_by_role("tab", name="Date").click()
    m.wait_for_timeout(400)
    m.screenshot(path="/tmp/date-mobile.png", full_page=True)
    # horizontal overflow check
    for name, page in (("desktop", pg), ("mobile", m)):
        over = page.evaluate(
            "document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth"
        )
        print(f"{name} horizontal overflow px:", over)
    b.close()

import urllib.request, lzma, re, os, subprocess, sys, threading, queue

BASE = "https://deb.debian.org/debian/"
IDX = BASE + "dists/trixie/main/binary-amd64/Packages.xz"
os.makedirs("/tmp/deps/debs", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("/tmp/deps/root", exist_ok=True)

raw = lzma.open(urllib.request.urlopen(IDX, timeout=120)).read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
pkgs = {}
for stanza in raw.split("\n\n"):
    name = fn = depends = None
    for line in stanza.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("Package: "): name = line[9:].strip()
        elif line.startswith("Filename: "): fn = line[10:].strip()
        elif line.startswith("Depends: "): depends = line[9:].strip()
    if name and fn:
        pkgs[name] = (fn, depends or "")
print("index packages:", len(pkgs), flush=True)

roots = """libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0t64 libatk-bridge2.0-0t64 libcups2t64 libdbus-1-3
libatspi2.0-0t64 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libpango-1.0-0
libcairo2 libasound2t64 libxkbcommon0 libglib2.0-0t64 libx11-6 libxcb1 libxext6 libexpat1
libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libdrm2 libdrm-amdgpu1 fonts-dejavu-core
fonts-liberation2 libegl1 libgl1 libxi6 libxtst6 libxrender1 libx11-xcb1 libxcb-dri3-0
libxshmfence1 libwayland-client0 libwayland-server0 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0
libxcb-shm0 libxcursor1 libxinerama1 libpangoft2-1.0-0 libgraphite2-3 libharfbuzz0b
libthai0 libdatrie1 libfribidi0 libbrotli1 libbz2-1.0 liblzma5 libzstd1 libuuid1
libselinux1 libpcre2-8-0 libmount1 libblkid1 libudev1 libcap2 libgcrypt20 libgpg-error0
libsystemd0 liblz4-1 libz1 libffi8""".split()

wanted, todo = {}, list(roots)
missing = []
while todo:
    name = todo.pop()
    if name in wanted:
        continue
    if name not in pkgs:
        # try versionless/renamed variants
        alt = [k for k in pkgs if k.split(":")[0] == name]
        if not alt:
            missing.append(name); continue
        name = alt[0]
        if name in wanted: continue
    fn, dep = pkgs[name]
    wanted[name] = fn
    for alt in dep.split(","):
        cand = alt.strip().split("|")[0].strip()
        cand = cand.split("(")[0].strip().split(":")[0].strip()
        if cand and not cand.startswith("<"):
            todo.append(cand)

print("resolved:", len(wanted), "missing:", missing, flush=True)

q = queue.Queue()
for fn in sorted(set(wanted.values())): q.put(fn)
errors = []
def work():
    while True:
        try: fn = q.get_nowait()
        except queue.Empty: return
        out = "/tmp/deps/" + fn.replace("/", "_")
        if os.path.exists(out): continue
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(BASE + fn, timeout=120) as r, open(out, "wb") as f:
                f.write(r.read())
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append((fn, str(e)))
threads = [threading.Thread(target=work) for _ in range(6)]
[t.start() for t in threads]; [t.join() for t in threads]
print("downloaded:", len(os.listdir("/tmp/deps")), "errors:", errors[:5], flush=True)

for deb in os.listdir("/tmp/deps"):
    if not deb.endswith(".deb"): continue
    subprocess.run(["dpkg-deb", "-x", "/tmp/deps/" + deb, "/tmp/deps/root"], check=False)
print("extracted", flush=True)

# Meridian — project notes for the next workers

## Current state

- `preview.html` + `static/css/style.css` — the design system and static preview shell from
  task 1 (mode rail, readouts, keypad, plot, calendar). Mode switching is already wired
  inline via `body[data-mode]` and `[data-mode-target]` / `[data-panel]`.
  **It does not load the engine yet** — add
  `<script src="static/js/engine.js"></script>` before your UI script.
- `static/js/engine.js` — the shared maths engine (task 2). Classic script, ES5 syntax,
  attaches `window.CalcEngine`. No imports/exports/eval/new Function/DOM.

## Engine contract (window.CalcEngine)

Everything returns a value and **never throws**:

```js
CalcEngine.tokenize(src)            // { ok, tokens:[{type,value,text,start,end}] } | error
CalcEngine.parse(src)               // { ok, ast, tokens, variables } | error
CalcEngine.evaluate(src, opts)      // { ok, value, formatted, angleMode, variables } | error
CalcEngine.compile(src, opts)       // { ok, fn, variable, variables, angleMode, ast } | error
CalcEngine.selfTest()               // { ok, total, passed, failures } — 47 checks, all pass
CalcEngine.format.number(value, o)  // shared display string
CalcEngine.format.significant(v, n)
CalcEngine.format.scientific(v, o)  // { unicode:false } for plain "1.23e+6"
CalcEngine.format.group(text, sep)
CalcEngine.format.result(result)    // "4" or "Error: <message>"
```

Error shape: `{ ok:false, message:'…', position:1, near:'…' }` (`position` is 1-based, 0 if
unknown). Render `message` inline under the input; `near` is a short excerpt for context.

### Options
- `angleMode: 'rad' | 'deg' | 'grad'` (default **rad**). Also accepts `degrees:true` or
  `angle:'deg'`. Trig converts input, inverse trig converts output.
- `scope: { x: 2 }` (or `x: 2`) to bind variables for `evaluate`.
- `compile(expr).fn(x)` returns a **number**; undefined results are `NaN` (break the
  polyline there with `Number.isFinite`). `fn.lastError` holds the message for the last
  sample. `compile` also exposes `variable` (default `'x'`), so graph mode can sample any
  single free variable.
- Degree sign `°` is mode-aware: `sin(48°)` = 0.7431 in rad, deg and grad alike.

### Semantics worth knowing
- Precedence: `^` (right-assoc) > unary minus > `* / %` > `+ -`; `!` binds tighter than `^`.
  `-2^2 = -4`, `2^3^2 = 512`, `2^-3 = 0.125`.
- Implicit multiplication binds left-to-right at the multiplicative level:
  `2x`, `3(4+5)`, `(1+2)(3+4)`, `2sin(x)`, `pi x`; `1/2x` = `(1/2)·x`.
- `%` is binary remainder (JS semantics); division by zero yields `Infinity`, which formats
  as `∞`. `0/0` → `undefined`.
- Factorials need whole numbers ≥ 0 (error otherwise); > 170! → `Infinity`.
- Unknown names are runtime errors with a readable message; unknown `foo(` → "I do not know
  a function called foo". Brackets nest up to 32 levels (clear message beyond).
- Lexer accepts `× ÷ · − π τ φ √ °` and `**` (as `^`), so keypad labels can be pasted.

## Formatting conventions used by the preview

Default `sig` is 12 (matches the "12 significant digits" copy). Auto mode:
- fixed with thousands grouping: `1,234,567.891`, `0.333333333333`
- scientific from `1e12` up and below `1e-6`: `1×10¹²`, `1×10⁻⁷` (unicode)
- `Infinity` → `∞`, `NaN` → `undefined`, negative zero → `0`
- `{ typographic:true }` renders minus as U+2212 to match the serif readout styling.

## Verification

No node/browser in the sandbox. The engine was verified by executing it in QuickJS
(`pip install --target /tmp/pylibs quickjs`, then eval the file with `var window =
globalThis`) — 50+ expression cases, error-shape cases, compile/sampling (200k samples in
~0.4 s), formatting tables, ES5 syntax check via esprima. `CalcEngine.selfTest()` is the
quick in-browser equivalent; run it in the console if you suspect a regression.
